dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Hello, I am the Vizier. Do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vizier? What about your name?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: My name is Nizam, and Vizier is my title. I'm responsible for administrative matters in the Grand Bazaar and Treasures Street on behalf of the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: ...At least, that's what the official document says.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: In reality, I mostly deal with trivial matters. Anything the Mahamata don't want to deal with gets passed on to me...

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Said something about electing a new Grand Conservator, and things having gotten busier... Just another excuse.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Good to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have to deal with?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: For example, when it comes to the birthday of Lesser Lord Kusanali, residents nearby would come to the Akademiya to apply for funds to hold the Sabzeruz Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: But ever since the departure of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, the higher-ups stopped organizing the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: They're not responsible for dealing with questions and doubts from the residents. In the end, I'm the one who has to smooth things out... I have to handle all kinds of things.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: But as much as I complain about it, I'm still going to do as I should.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Grand Conservator?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Simply put, it's the director of the House of Daena in the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Everyone is free to request knowledge from the Akasha, but the access to some important texts and primary sources requires the approval of the Grand Conservator.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: So the scholars of the Akademiya are very concerned about this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter to me... But Vikram and I had drinks together, so I can't support him, or else it may look rather suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have to deal with?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: For example, when it comes to the birthday of the Dendro Archon, residents nearby would come to the Akademiya to apply for funds to hold the Sabzeruz Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Ever since Lesser Lord Kusanali reasserted control over the Akademiya, everyone's been even more fired up about this festival... and the number of requests has also shot up, as you might expect.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: I mean, I complain about it, but I'm still going to my job as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Grand Conservator?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Simply put, this is the director of the House of Daena in the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Ever since the Akasha was shut down, the number of people who have wanted to reference book collections has increased, and all such applications must go through the Grand Conservator.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: As such, the scholars of the Akademiya are very concerned about this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter to me... But Vikram and I have had drinks together, so I have to recuse myself from supporting him, or else it may look rather suspicious.
